query: 反歧视政策 反歧视政策 衡量企业在招聘、晋升、薪酬及日常管理中，针对消除基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等特征歧视的承诺、规则与执行机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：明确界定了受保护的多元特征（包含但不限于性别、民族、生理状况等）；且规定了面向全员的反歧视/DEI 专项培训要求。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的反歧视声明或包含在员工手册中，具备基础的公平雇佣承诺。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“依法合规雇佣”表述。 二、执行机制得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：具备匿名举报热线；有明确的违规调查处理流程。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：缺乏明确的举报渠道或未说明处理机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：未采取实质性的合规管理行动。 反歧视政策 禁止就业歧视 受保护特征 公平雇佣声明 反歧视培训 无意识偏见培训 歧视投诉 歧视调查处理 多元与共融 anti-discrimination policy non-discrimination in employment protected characteristics equal employment opportunity employment discrimination anti-discrimination training unconscious bias training discrimination complaint discrimination investigation diversity and inclusion 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反歧视政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法合规雇佣”口号；仅有多元化人数统计而无政策；仅有客户反歧视营销政策；仅有反骚扰但完全不涉及雇佣歧视时可谨慎区分；区分：反歧视政策关注禁止基于特定特征的歧视及合规执行；平等机会措施关注选拔流程公平与监控指标；员工申诉机制是通用渠道， alone 不能证明存在反歧视政策。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / Preventing Illegal Acts
results.text: The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / 5.2.2. Focusing on Employee Engagement
results.text: The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. When new recruit is on board, dual mentors, including an integrated mentor and a job-specific mentor, are assigned to each new employee. The integrated mentor is responsible for the training and development of employees' integrated capabilities and providing guidance on career path planning, while the job-specific mentor is responsible for providing training on job duties. To equip employees with the skill set that they need for their roles, the Group proactively provides a wide range of business and function-specific training to empower employees' growth and performance.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
People-oriented Workplace / 5.2.2. Focusing on Employee Engagement

[Content]
The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. When new recruit is on board, dual mentors, including an integrated mentor and a job-specific mentor, are assigned to each new employee. The integrated mentor is responsible for the training and development of employees' integrated capabilities and providing guidance on career path planning, while the job-specific mentor is responsible for providing training on job duties. To equip employees with the skill set that they need for their roles, the Group proactively provides a wide range of business and function-specific training to empower employees' growth and performance.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: Based on the Group's business nature, both standard and flexible work hour systems are adopted to suit the operational needs. To ensure appropriate work and rest schedules are arranged for employees, the Group stipulated the working days, normal working hours, and rest periods of employees in the Attendance Management Standard and it includes the appropriate arrangement of providing monetary compensation or granting of time off to compensate overtime work. The Group guarantees that all employees enjoy statutory holidays such as marriage leave, maternity leave, funeral leave, and paid annual leave.
